gloss: before the gods; in front of a Shinto altar

definitions.gloss: before the gods; in front of a Shinto altar
definitions.explanation: The space in front of a Shinto deity or its altar, where rites, offerings and vows are made.

examples.japanese: {神前|しんぜん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{誓|ちか}う→誓う：00030_chikau⟧。
examples.english: To make a vow before the gods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{巫女|みこ}→巫女：12408_miko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{神前|しんぜん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{舞|ま}っている→舞う：04573_mau⟧。
examples.english: A shrine maiden is dancing before the altar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{神前式|しんぜんしき}→神前式：28943_shinzenshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げ→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The two held a Shinto wedding at a shrine and celebrated with just their families.

notes:
A formal word, used mostly in connection with Shinto rites.
